comment: Tests allowed to build an external app reply inline. "deliberate" needs a reason no real app reply would do; "pending" is a to-do that scripts/check-recorded-replies.mjs makes you delete (#1237). "noBehaviour" lists a recording no test replays because Deluno has no behaviour for the call it shows; scripts/check-recorded-replies.mjs fails for any other recording that no test names.

entries.reason: The uTorrent part still build their replies inline (#1237, the owner will have them tested properly later). uTorrent is not installed on the golden VM, so no reply of its is recorded. To move this file onto recordings, record from the real uTorrent WebUI (/gui/): the token page (token.html); list=1 with a running download, a paused one, a finished (seeding) one, a stalled one, a queued one and no job at all (the positional rows, label at index 11, and the build number); action=add-url and action=add-file for a new torrent and for one it already holds; action=getprops (seed ratio and time) and action=setprops s=label for a known and an unknown hash; action=getfiles for a one-file and a many-file torrent; action=pause, unpause, start, stop, remove and removedata for a known and an unknown hash; the free-space settings call; and a wrong login (HTTP 401).

noBehaviour.reason: SABnzbd's mode=change_cat on a queued job. Deluno sets a Usenet job's category only when it adds it; it never moves an existing Usenet job to another category (keep-seeding moves are for torrents).
SABnzbd's mode=change_cat to a category it does not have. Deluno never moves an existing Usenet job to another category.
NZBGet's editqueue GroupSetCategory on a queued job. Deluno never moves an existing Usenet job to another category.
